entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Mike. How can I help you today?
Hi Mike, I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I got it a couple of weeks ago.
Oh, absolutely, that's no problem at all. I can get that started for you right away. As long as it's within 10 days of delivery, you're all set.
Wow, that was fast. Okay, great. So what do I do?

I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email we have on file for you now. Just print it out, stick it on the box, and drop it off. And, one moment... I see here you're a VIP member with us. To thank you for your loyalty, I've just added a $25 credit to your account for your next VeloFit purchase.
A credit too? That's really generous, thank you so much, Mike!
You're very welcome. You should see that email with the return label in the next five minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's perfect. Thanks again for making it so easy.
My pleasure. Thanks for calling VeloFit and have a great day!
